summary.zh-TW: 帳號設定頁的四個分頁：點分頁時，底線滑到它下方並變成它的寬度，內容往分頁移動的方向滑進來。方向鍵也能切換。
summary.en: Four tabs on an account page: the underline slides under the chosen tab and matches its width, and the content slides in from the direction you moved. Arrow keys work too.

text.zh-TW: 整排分頁只有一條底線。量出被選中分頁的位置和寬度，用 x 移過去、用 scaleX 縮放成同樣寬。只動 transform，比直接改 width、left 順。
text.en: There is just one underline. It measures the chosen tab’s position and width, moves with x and stretches with scaleX. Only transforms change, which is smoother than animating width or left.

text.zh-TW: scaleX 從左邊為基準縮放，x 才會剛好對齊分頁的左緣。少了這行，底線會從中間往兩邊縮放而錯位。
text.en: scaleX grows from the left edge so x lines up with the tab’s left side. Without it the line scales from its centre and drifts.

text.zh-TW: 往右邊的分頁切換時內容從右邊滑進來，往左就從左邊。方向和底線一致，空間感比單純淡入淡出清楚。
text.en: Moving to a tab on the right brings content in from the right, and vice versa. Matching the underline’s direction gives a clearer sense of space than a plain fade.

text.zh-TW: 快速連點不同分頁時，先停掉上一段還沒跑完的動畫，從目前的位置直接滑向新的分頁。
text.en: When tabs are clicked quickly, the unfinished animation is stopped and the line slides from where it is toward the new tab.

text.zh-TW: 照 WAI-ARIA 的分頁規範：Tab 鍵只會進到選中的分頁，用方向鍵切換其他分頁，Home／End 跳到頭尾。
text.en: Following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: Tab only reaches the selected tab, arrow keys move between tabs, and Home/End jump to the ends.
